name: Report
summary: The document wrapper. Every artifact should start with this.

name: Eyebrow
summary: Small uppercase kicker above the title.

name: Lede
summary: The large intro paragraph under the title.

name: SectionNum
summary: A section marker, e.g. <SectionNum>01 — Metrics</SectionNum> before an <h2>.

name: Grid
summary: Responsive grid of cards.

name: Card
summary: A panel. `title` renders with the standard leading dot.

name: Chips
summary: Metadata row: <Chips><Chip label="Period" value="Q3" /></Chips>

name: Chip
summary: One metadata chip, e.g. label="Period" value="Q3 FY26".

name: Stats
summary: Row of KPI tiles. Wrap <Stat> children in this.

name: Stat
summary: A KPI tile — the big-number-is-the-hero block. `delta` renders a coloured ▲/▼ (positive is up). `feature` spotlights one tile.

props.name: delta
props.doc: Signed change; sign picks the arrow and the colour.

props.name: deltaLabel
props.doc: Override the delta text, e.g. "+12% QoQ".

name: Bars
summary: Horizontal bar chart. Pass percentages (0–100) — the CSS draws the fill.

props.name: data
props.type: { label: ReactNode; value: number; tone?: Tone; display?: string }[]

name: Donuts
summary: Ring gauges for single share/completion figures.

props.name: data
props.type: { label: ReactNode; value: number; tone?: Tone }[]

name: Spark
summary: Tiny inline sparkline. You pass the numbers; the geometry is computed.

name: Chart
summary: Trend/area chart with grid, fill, and an emphasised endpoint.

name: Table
summary: Data table. `rows` are plain cell values — strings, numbers, or the cell helpers below (<Status>, <Pill>, <MiniBar>). `stripes` adds a leading severity bar per row.

name: Status
summary: Table cell: coloured dot + label.

name: Pill
summary: Table cell: solid status pill.

name: MiniBar
summary: Table cell: inline proportion bar (0–100).

name: Note
summary: Short status notice. Use Decision when there is a verdict.

name: Callout
summary: Tinted highlight panel with a small tag.

name: Decision
summary: The recommendation box — a verdict as the hero.

name: Steps
summary: Numbered sequence — only when order genuinely matters.

name: Timeline
summary: Gantt-style roadmap. `start` is 1-based; `span` is a column count.

props.name: rows
props.type: { label: ReactNode; start: number; span: number; tone?: Tone; ghost?: boolean }[]

name: Icon
summary: A Lucide icon, by name (e.g. "trending-up", "check-circle", "building-2"). The sandbox has NO network, so an icon cannot be fetched — the parent resolves the ones your source mentions into inline SVG and injects them. That means the name must be a literal string here, not built at runtime: `<Icon name="rocket" />` works, `<Icon name={someVar} />` cannot be seen by the scanner and renders nothing. Colour is inherited (`currentColor`), so set it on a parent. This is the ONLY way to show imagery in an artifact besides a data: URI — remote logos and images are blocked by the sandbox and will not appear.

name: Submit
summary: Sends a VALUE the user chose back to the agent.

name: Action
summary: Sends a fixed follow-up message, like clicking a suggestion.
